subject: EOQ compute sponsorship — short runway for LumenAI pilot
messages:
From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@lumenai.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenAI Ops <ops@lumenai.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — short runway for pilot (possible consumption top-up)

Hi Sofia,

We’re seeing a spike in usage this week as our team ramps the LumenAI pilot toward a hard EOQ demo (internal stakeholder review next Friday). We’re close to exhausting the trial allocation you provided. Can Redwood temporarily sponsor additional compute so we don’t hit the cap during the demo window?

Numbers: roughly +120k tokens/day projected over the next 5 days (estimate attached). If we throttle now the demo will have degraded latency and some evaluation checks will fail.

If Redwood can cover a short consumption window (or issue a temporary credit), we’ll be in a much stronger position to buy committed Dedicated capacity next quarter — the buying signal is real.

Appreciate any quick help, happy to jump on a 15-min call.

—Sarah
Attachment: lumenai-weekly-usage.csv (CSV, 24KB)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@lumenai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short runway for pilot (possible consumption top-up)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the data.

We can offer a short-term consumption sponsorship for the demo window, subject to approval from revenue ops and a simple one-page terms attachment (I’ll loop finance for a quick check). Proposed coverage: up to $3,500 of additional consumption (equivalent to ~600k tokens at current rates) for the next 7 days. That should cover your peak and give you a safety buffer.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm a realistic peak day token estimate so we don’t overshoot?
- Please confirm that any PII in evaluation traffic is covered under your SOC2 handling (so we can keep this as a sponsored demo, not a special data arrangement).

If you’re good, I’ll route this for approval now and send a short terms PDF for signature.

Chat? I’m free at 10:30.

Thanks,
Sofia
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short runway for pilot (possible consumption top-up)

+1 from me — LumenAI has been active in the last 6 weeks and this looks like a high-leverage close. A short consumption sponsorship is the low-friction option.

If we set $3.5k cap: recommend we attach a follow-up milestone: commit to a 6-month Dedicated minimum within 30 days post-demo or we convert consumed sponsorship into a first-month credit (protects revenue).

Also want to confirm we’re ok with the support handoff: CS should be on standby to smooth the demo. Lauren, can you confirm CS availability Wed-Fri?

—Ben
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — approval for limited consumption sponsorship

Thanks for the context. Approved with conditions:
1) Cap at $3,500 total and 7-day window starting on confirmation timestamp.
2) LumenAI signs the one-page sponsorship terms (standard RDW sponsorship template).
3) Sales to document the post-demo commitment path (HubSpot deal note + expected next steps).
4) No changes to data handling or privacy terms — they must use existing SOC2 processes.

Ben — OK to proceed. Lauren — please confirm CS coverage and we’ll route the PDF for signature.

Marcus
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@lumenai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmation: EOQ compute sponsorship (next steps + terms)

Hi Sarah — good news: internal approvals came through.

Summary of sponsorship (see attached one-pager):
- Amount: up to $3,500 of sponsored consumption
- Window: 7 days from your confirmation reply (we’ll set the activation timestamp when you say go)
- Condition: LumenAI signs the one-page sponsorship-terms.pdf and confirms SOC2 handling for demo traffic
- Post-demo: sales will capture a commitment path in HubSpot; expected follow-up is a Dedicated capacity conversation within 30 days of a successful demo.

Attachments: consumption-sponsorship-terms.pdf (PDF, 6 pages) — please review, sign, and return. Once we receive the signed PDF we’ll activate the sponsorship immediately.

Lauren — CS coverage confirmed for Wed-Fri, per your note.

Sarah — if you want me to activate on Monday morning local time, reply with a quick confirm and I’ll send the DocuSign link.

Thanks all — let’s get this demo across the finish line.

Best,
Sofia
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: consumption-sponsorship-terms.pdf (PDF)
